lead: The process's drain bit is begun by other cases in the same test binary, so a new case may not rest on it.
body: `nvs-cli`'s serve cases end an in-process server by dropping `EndsTheServer`, which calls `nvs_server::Draining::process().begin()`, and that bit is one per process rather than one per case — a case reading it reads whatever its neighbours have already done to it. Take `nvs_runtime::Drain::detached()` for anything a case has to be able to *not* drain, and end what the case started by withdrawing it rather than by draining the process.
